page_annotations: The page is mostly blank ruled paper, with a left margin rule. It has only two entries.

Shelfmarks of the facing page fol. 332 are visible right of the gutter. These are d. 1027, f. 91, cancelled e. 234, d. 1006, e. 234, d. 339(1), f. 76, d. 1089, d. 999(2), etc., with ticks and a curved bracket from d. 1072 to d. 996. They are facing-page fragments and are not transcribed as target records.
No faint pencil or bottom-margin notes were found on image review.

coverage.finding: Folio number '331' with a raised 'b' and a following small dot, top left at about [460,355]. The candidate reading is acceptable.

Single-line entry 'd: 989(4)' with the title, subject, 'Unf.' and the date column 'n.d.: 150: 8: D.'. The shelfmark sits in the margin column. The separator between 'Medical' and 'Unf.' is a short low stroke. It may be a period or a dash.

A right-pointing arrow at about x 3010–3230, y about 1610–1650. Its head ends at the gutter, opposite the facing-page line 'd. 999(2) Vaidyaka (Bhāṣā°)'. On fol. 332 this arrow appears entering from the left, which confirms the positional link.

Single-line entry with a tick, 'd. 201(2)', the title, author, 'following Dhanañjaya', 'ff.1-24', the owner note and 'n.d.: 24:7:D'. The tick and shelfmark start left of the margin rule. The title begins in the margin column and crosses the rule.

A double-headed arrow at about x 2985–3160, y about 3700–3750. On fol. 332 it reaches the level between d. 1079 and the cross-reference line 'Śambhunātha, Jātakacandraka'. The exact target is not certain.

changes.reason: The entry contains a written ownership note, 'Owner, Paṇḍita Raghunātha'. Recording it as a structured field keeps it distinct from the author. The reading of the name is still tentative.

unresolved.issue: The mark between 'Medical' and 'Unf.' is a short, low horizontal stroke. It may be a period, as the candidate gives it, or a dash.
unresolved.next_check: Compare with the native tile at about x 1600–1960, y about 1650, and with this hand's punctuation elsewhere.

unresolved.issue: The title may read 'Harināmāmālā', with a macron over the second 'a' of 'nāma'. The candidate already notes this as uncertain.
unresolved.next_check: Inspect at higher magnification at about x 600–1000, y 3720–3780.

unresolved.issue: There is a faint small stroke at the extreme left page edge, at about x 340, y 1670, beside the d: 989(4) line. There is also a tiny mark at the left edge at about x 322, y 4540. They are probably paper blemishes, but a faint tick cannot be excluded.
unresolved.next_check: Check the original or a higher-contrast image of the left page edge.

unresolved.issue: The facing-page target of the double arrow is uncertain. It may be the space between d. 1079 and d. 1072(8), or the cross-reference line 'Śambhunātha, Jātakacandraka'.
unresolved.next_check: Align fol. 332 native coordinates with the arrow's right end at about y 3700–3750.
